name: think
description: Front-door thinking skills for Claude Code: smart (sharpen a vague goal into a measurable + convergent, think-deep-ready statement — the kit's IFR builder), ideate (generate 5–15 diverse candidate ideas, adversarially select the best against a pinned merit rubric), and reflect (distil the working method from the current dialogue's corrections into a reusable instruction, then propose reconciling it with the project's knowledge base). Compose the magic plugin's critic; feed think!! / run!! / gauntlet!!. Stack-agnostic, no project files.
